vedic_reference.note: Jasveeran is a name derived from the Sanskrit language and is rooted in Vedic mythology. The name is a combination of the words 'जस' (Jas), which means wisdom, knowledge, and 'वीर' (Veer), which means brave, heroic. The suffix 'आन' (Aan) signifies 'one who has'. In Vedic mythology, Jasveeran can be associated with the god Vishnu, who is known for his wisdom and strength.
